newsitem.title: CANADA: Hartwell Petroleums bought by CrownJoule.
newsitem.headline: Hartwell Petroleums bought by CrownJoule.

text.p: CrownJoule Exploration Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday that it had succeeded in its offer to purchase all outstanding common shares of Hartwell Petroleums Ltd.

A total of 21,382,805 shares representing over 98 percent of the outstanding HartWell shares were tendered prior to the expiry time and the remaining were acquired by HartWell under the compulsory acquisition provisions of applicable corporate legislation, the CrownJoule statement said.
New Cache Petroleums Ltd. and Inter West Energy Corporation acquired subsidiaries of HartWell which owned 44 percent and 22 percent respectively of the former HartWell assets, the statement said.
New Cache acquired all the issued and outstanding shares of 717089 Alberta Ltd., a private oil and gas company for approximately $21 million.

The assets of the company include a 44 percent working interest in nine producing and one cased gas well in the Doris Lower Mannville "D" Pool, a 14.5 percent working interest in the Doris Gas Plant (capacity 18 mmcfd), with an option to increase our ownership to 22 percent and 89,600 gross (25,830 net) undeveloped acres, the majority of which surrounds the Doris property, New Cache said.
The acquisition also includes approximately $3.5 million of tax pools.
The $21 million purchase price is financed from an available line of credit of $25 million, New Cache said.
CrownJoule retained the shares of a HartWell subsidiary which in turn owned 34 percent of the original HartWell assets, it said. ((Gilbert Le Gras 204 947 3548))
